scenarios.title: Using only a fresh UUID browser profile partition, open run-owned local HTML in Native, Grab a paragraph without preceding hover then a second element; highlight/Copied/payload real clipboard; page button not activated; Change then Question annotations rearm, two pins and tray; Escape cancels. Never use or clear shared Default native storage.

In run-owned Native page, ordinary Mod+C copies selected text and editable input text without arming picker; with no selection/editable focus Mod+C arms Grab, Mod+Shift+C Annotate. C copies hovered context while armed. Native S/Draw explicitly explains unavailable public snapshot capability, with no OS screen capture or engine switch.

Native guest evaluation/armed picker navigation, pane close, hidden tab and replaced handle cancel outstanding requests/listeners; late messages cannot update another same-URL pane or produce clipboard writes; host annotation dialogs/trays mask the native layer and remain keyboard reachable. Fresh UUID partition only.
